name: free-solo
description: Free Solo: a tiny endless climbing game you can drop into any page as <free-solo></free-solo> or mount(el).

scripts.build: esbuild src/index.js --bundle --format=esm --minify --target=es2019 --outfile=dist/free-solo.js --log-override:duplicate-object-key=silent --banner:js="/*! Free Solo. Bundles Phaser 3.80.1 (MIT License, (c) Richard Davey, Photon Storm Ltd.) */"
